limitations: This does not establish that Marcus’s interpretation was wrong.

from_speaker: sorta kinda acknowledging the point I was making

our_interpretation: The surrounding text identifies Marcus’s point as the distinction between passing supplied tests and producing correct, secure, maintainable, well-architected software.

“Sorta kinda” leaves the degree and directness of acknowledgment unspecified. Requiring an explicit concession, or counting any admission of limitations, would introduce a threshold Marcus did not supply.
“Rare note of realism” is an evaluative description without a defined comparison period or standard.
The allowance for an ordinary reading of firm language does not justify converting this hedged assessment into a firm factual commitment.
criteria.support_condition: No faithful binary support condition can be set for the statement as written. Records can establish Brockman’s words, but cannot determine the unspecified degree of acknowledgment Marcus meant.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No faithful binary contradiction condition can be set. Failure to find an explicit concession would not disprove “sorta kinda” acknowledgment, and “rare realism” lacks an objective standard.
